ITBP Head Constable (Motor Mechanic) Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Indo-Tibetan Border Police Force (ITBP) has released the short notice for the post of Head Constable (Motor Mechanic) Group-C (Non-Gazetted). This recruitment has been issued for 21 posts. The online application process for ITBP Head Constable (Motor Mechanic) Recruitment 2026 will start from 28 September 2026, and candidates can apply until 27 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for ITBP Head Constable (Motor Mechanic) Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 28 September 2026
  • Last Date : 27 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, EBC, BC : Rs.100/-
  • SC, ST, Female : Rs. 00/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
